items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1973-09-07
items.q: Cat Garland and a lot of guys, ace trombone players around, they had a fella called Happy, he played with his foot.

ctx.x: Yeah. I'm teaching Chicago, I have pupils. And that's my theory. I'd rather have them make one nice round good tone than six bad ones. Now I have one fella, he's got a nice big tone already. He's been trying to teach himself. His name is David Mertz. And so he's been under my wing about two months now. And the only trouble he has is say like one, two, three, four. He has trouble just keeping time with his feet. Well I can play and I just don't have to pat my feet. Yeah, he was falling in the middle of the thing.…
